enterprises.name: Homage
enterprises.description: Homage is a Singapore on-demand service that matches licensed care professionals with seniors for home nursing, companionship and therapy visits, billing per visit and offering subscription care plans to families.
enterprises.highlights: 亚洲居家照护平台标杆，国内可对标居家上门照护模式
enterprises.desc_cn: Homage 是新加坡按需上门照护服务，将持证护理员匹配给老人做居家护理、陪伴与康复探访，按次计费并向家庭出售照护套餐。
enterprises.recommend: 【Homage】聚焦居家护理，亚洲居家照护平台标杆，国内可对标居家上门照护模式。

enterprises.name: Trusty.care
enterprises.description: Trusty.care gives insurance agents a quoting and enrollment system for Medicare Advantage, Supplement and long-term-care policies, with client needs-analysis and carrier connectivity, charging agents and agencies a subscription.
enterprises.highlights: 保险侧会员运营，对国内长护险商业化有启发
enterprises.desc_cn: Trusty.care 为保险代理人供应联邦医保优势、补充险与长期护理险的报价与投保系统，含客户需求和分析与保险公司对接，向代理人收订阅费。
enterprises.recommend: 【Trusty.care】聚焦保险科技/养老金融，保险侧会员运营，对国内长护险商业化有启发。

enterprises.name: Elder
enterprises.description: Elder is a UK service that matches older adults needing round-the-clock help with vetted live-in carers within 24 hours, handling matching, contracts and backup cover while charging families a weekly care fee.
enterprises.highlights: 居家照护供给侧匹配模式，可对标国内护工平台
enterprises.desc_cn: Elder 是英国居家全时照护服务，24 小时内为需全天候照料的老人匹配经审核的住家护理员，负责匹配、合同与替补，按周向家庭收费。
enterprises.recommend: 【Elder】聚焦居家护理，居家照护供给侧匹配模式，可对标国内护工平台。

enterprises.name: Patronus
enterprises.description: Patronus, based in Berlin, sells a smartwatch with built-in SIM that connects seniors directly to a 24/7 emergency call centre and a companion app that updates relatives on location and wellbeing, on a device-plus-subscription model.
enterprises.highlights: 聚焦老年医疗数字化空白
enterprises.desc_cn: Patronus 总部位于柏林，销售内置 SIM 卡的智能应急手表，老人可一键直连 24 小时急救中心，配套应用向家属实时同步位置与状态，走设备加订阅模式。
enterprises.recommend: 【Patronus】聚焦健康管理，聚焦老年医疗数字化空白。
